q-40413.name: Question 1
q-40413.problem: Let $a=[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 1 \\ -3 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$ and $b=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -2 \\ 2 \\ 2\end{aligned}].$ Find the orthogonal projection of $a$ onto $\text{Span}\{b\}.$
q-40413.worked_solution:
The orthogonal projection of $a$ onto $\text{span}\{b\}$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{b}\,a & =\frac{b\cdot a}{b\cdot b}b \\  & =\frac{2\cdot (-5)+(-2)\cdot 1+2\cdot (-3)+2\cdot 1}{{2}^{2}+(-2)^{2}+{2}^{2}+{2}^{2}}b \\  & =\frac{-10-2-6+2}{4+4+4+4}b \\  & =\frac{-16}{16}b \\  & =-b \\  & =-1[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -2 \\ 2 \\ 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 2 \\ -2 \\ -2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

q-39708.name: Question 2
q-39708.problem: Let $a=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 2 \\ -3 \\ 3\end{aligned}]$ and $b=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{aligned}].$ Find the orthogonal projection of $a$ onto $\text{Span}\{b\}.$
q-39708.worked_solution:
The orthogonal projection of $a$ onto $\text{Span}\{b\}$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{b}\,a & =\frac{b\cdot a}{b\cdot b}b \\  & =\frac{2\cdot 3+0\cdot 2+(-2)\cdot (-3)+2\cdot 3}{{2}^{2}+{0}^{2}+(-2)^{2}+{2}^{2}}b \\  & =\frac{6+0+6+6}{4+0+4+4}b \\  & =\frac{18}{12}b \\  & =\frac{3}{2}b \\  & =\frac{3}{2}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 0 \\ -3 \\ 3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

q-81124.problem: Let $a=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 2 \\ -1 \\ 5\end{aligned}]$ and $b=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}].$ Find the orthogonal projection of $a$ onto $\text{Span}\{b\}.$
q-81124.worked_solution:
The orthogonal projection of $a$ onto $\text{Span}\{b\}$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{b}\,a & =\frac{b\cdot a}{b\cdot b}b \\  & =\frac{1\cdot 2+1\cdot 2+0\cdot (-1)+1\cdot 5}{{1}^{2}+{1}^{2}+{0}^{2}+{1}^{2}}b \\  & =\frac{2+2+0+5}{1+1+0+1}b \\  & =\frac{9}{3}b \\  & =3b \\  & =3[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 3 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

q-39727.problem: Let $a=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ -3 \\ 4\end{aligned}]$ and $b=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 2 \\ -3 \\ 1\end{aligned}].$ Find the orthogonal projection of $a$ onto $\text{Span}\{b\}.$
q-39727.worked_solution:
The orthogonal projection of $a$ onto $\text{Span}\{b\}$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{b}\,a & =\frac{b\cdot a}{b\cdot b}b \\  & =\frac{4\cdot 1+2\cdot 2+(-3)\cdot (-3)+1\cdot 4}{{4}^{2}+{2}^{2}+(-3)^{2}+{1}^{2}}b \\  & =\frac{4+4+9+4}{16+4+9+1}b \\  & =\frac{21}{30}b \\  & =\frac{7}{10}b \\  & =\frac{7}{10}[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 2 \\ -3 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{14}{5} \\ \frac{7}{5} \\ -\frac{21}{10} \\ \frac{7}{10}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

q-39730.problem: Let $b=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 4 \\ -4 \\ 2\end{aligned}]$ and $a=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 2 \\ -2 \\ 6\end{aligned}].$ Find the orthogonal projection of $b$ onto $\text{Span}\{a\}.$
q-39730.worked_solution:
The vector projection of $b$ onto $\text{Span}\{a\}$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{a}\,b & =\frac{a\cdot b}{a\cdot a}a \\  & =\frac{6\cdot 2+2\cdot 4+(-2)\cdot (-4)+6\cdot 2}{{6}^{2}+{2}^{2}+(-2)^{2}+{6}^{2}}a \\  & =\frac{12+8+8+12}{36+4+4+36}a \\  & =\frac{40}{80}a \\  & =\frac{1}{2}a \\  & =\frac{1}{2}[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 2 \\ -2 \\ 6\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 1 \\ -1 \\ 3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
